coverage_explanation: Tests one-second counting, two button-triggered resets, continued counting after each reset, and released-button behavior. The requirement does not specify the initial count, whether reset restarts the one-second phase, or overflow behavior. Post-reset numeric ranges accommodate either a retained or restarted clock phase; exact initial value and overflow are not tested.
assumptions: The authoritative TM1637 connections are CLK=D4 and DIO=D5; the reset button is D2.
Relies on the disclosed bench default: the button connects D2 to GND, uses INPUT_PULLUP, and is pressed LOW.
The displayed timer is a numeric count incremented once per second.
Initial count, reset clock-phase policy, held-button repetition policy, and overflow behavior are unspecified. Tests use short, separated presses and avoid requiring a particular clock-phase policy.
The reference chooses an initial count of zero, edge-triggered reset with debounce, a restarted clock phase on reset, and wraparound after 9999.
